from: October book, night 16 (A Happy Holy Day)
p1: Long ago, Isaiah told the people what Heavenly Father said. He taught them about the Sabbath, the Lord’s holy day of rest each week.
Some people were using His special day just to do whatever they wanted.
So the Lord said, “Call the Sabbath a delight.” A delight is something that makes your heart smile.
p2: The Lord asked them to follow His ways on that day, not their own. Then He promised, “You will delight in the Lord.” His day would bring them joy.
Now our Sabbath is Sunday, the day Jesus rose again. We go to church and remember Him. What could you do on Sunday to feel close to Jesus?
old: Long ago, a prophet named Isaiah lived in a city called Jerusalem. A prophet is someone Heavenly Father helps to speak for Him. The people there were good at being busy. Even on the one day Heavenly Father saved for Him, they ran to work and sell and shout, and that day felt just like all the others.

Heavenly Father had made the world in six days and rested on the seventh. So He gave His people one day each week to stop and rest and be close to Him. That day is called the Sabbath. Sabbath means rest.

So Isaiah said, "Turn your feet away from your own busy plans on My holy day. Call the Sabbath a delight." A delight is something so good it makes you happy all the way through, like a warm hug or your favorite song.

Then came the promise: "You will be happy in the Lord, and I will make you ride on the high places." In Isaiah's day, standing high on a hill meant you were safe and strong, with everything spread out below you. That is how Heavenly Father says a Sabbath heart feels. And the Lord that Isaiah promised we would be happy in is Jesus. Jesus called Himself the Lord of the Sabbath, because the day is His.

Wren tried it. On Sunday morning she wanted to run outside with her toys, but instead she sat down close to her family and listened to a quiet song. Her feet still wanted to go. But by the end she felt warm and slow and glad, like the day had room in it. Tomorrow your house can have one slow part too: a song, a story, a hand to hold.
